city_tips.title: Use the Opal Card System
city_tips.content: Purchase an Opal card at news agents or airport stations for discounted fares on trains, metro, light rail, ferries and buses.
city_tips.evidence: Sydney's public transport fare system is called Opal. The fare system covers all train, metro, light rail, ferry and bus services in Sydney

city_tips.title: Visit in Spring or Autumn
city_tips.content: September through May offers mild temperatures perfect for beach visits and outdoor activities.
city_tips.evidence: Trains service every station in the metropolitan area at least every 30 minutes.

city_tips.title: Explore Multicultural Dining
city_tips.content: Sydney's diverse cuisine reflects its multicultural community with affordable ethnic restaurants.
city_tips.evidence: Sydney's multicultural demography means plenty of quality ethnic cuisine for cheap eats, particularly Asian restaurants in Chinatown

city_tips.title: Beach Safety Between Flags
city_tips.content: When swimming at beaches, always swim between the yellow and red flags.
city_tips.evidence: The main thing to remember when swimming at any beach is to swim between the yellow and red flags.
